# 2 Clement — Chapter 19 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 19
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Brothers and sisters, I am reading you this exhortation from God's truth so that you will pay attention to what is written — and save both yourselves and the person reading to you.
2. What I ask as payment is this: repent with all your hearts. Give yourselves salvation and life. If we do this, we will lay a foundation for all the young people who want to work hard at becoming devout and God-loving.
3. When someone corrects us and calls us back from wrong to right, let us not be so foolish as to get annoyed and push back.
4. Sometimes we do harmful things without realizing it, because of the divided hearts and disbelief that live inside us, and our understanding gets clouded by empty desires.
5. Let us practice righteousness so that we will ultimately be saved. Blessed are those who keep these instructions — even if they go through hardship in this world for a little while, they will harvest the undying fruit of the resurrection.
6. The godly person should not be discouraged by present suffering. A blessed time is coming.
7. When they are raised back to life with those who have already been raised, they will rejoice forever in a world that never ends — having endured nothing ultimately painful.
